title.text: Phase 4 trust and verification: UX wireframes

v1.text: V1: the risk-of-bias rules are written for one review. The benchmark list is UAV weed datasets (risk_of_bias.py:23), the metrics are segmentation metrics (:34), and any study not on UAV imagery is rated High (:65). Another review gets ratings that mean nothing (lesson 21). Board 3.

v2.text: V2: it is labelled QUADAS-2 / PROBAST but scores reporting completeness from extracted fields. Any mention of 'label' makes ground truth Low risk (risk_of_bias.py:30, :108), against its own note that a sentence is not proof. Trust levels still read it as overall risk. Board 3.

v3.text: V3: a correction or addendum counts as 'flagged' (retraction.py:23-27), and any flag makes a claim BLOCKED (trust_context.py:133), although the retraction report itself calls corrections low-severity (retraction.py:244). The severity list in trust_context.py:40 is never used. Boards 2 and 6.

v4.text: V4: no pipeline stage produces Phase-4 inputs (records.json, phase4/_manifest.json, synthesis/consensus.json, COI chunk files). The harness only lists them as hand-off paths (handoff.py:65-69); the pipeline writes synthesis_matrix.json and literature_review.md instead. Board 1 and 7.

v5.text: V5: the COI audit needs exactly eight files named coi_chunk_1..8 (coi.py:122): one review's batching, fixed in code.

v6.text: V6: retraction is checked last, after extraction and synthesis (skill workflow notes). A retracted paper is cheap to catch at screening and expensive to find after data extraction. Board 2.

v7.text: V7: trust rules are fixed policy: STRONG needs at least one public data link and no industry entity of any kind (trust_context.py:137). No per-field setting and no sensitivity analysis. Board 6.

v8.text: V8 (strengths): deterministic outputs; refuses rather than invents coverage; unresolved lookups kept as sentinels; per-domain reasons stored for manual override; verbatim quote checking is kept separate from similarity and documented as such.

v9.text: V9: the open-science scan drops studies without extracted text by default (drop_missing=True) and lists them only in run metadata, so the denominator shrinks quietly. Board 4.
